subject.title: Feature: Floating agent bubbles (Clawi) for macOS

question: Should OpenClaw core own native macOS floating per-agent bubbles now, expose a native macOS UI/window plugin API first, or defer this desktop bubble UX?
rationale: The request fits the companion-app direction but changes native windowing, persisted state ownership, accessibility/click-through behavior, and selected-agent chat routing, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Design the macOS bubble contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS owners define the core window, state, routing, persistence, and accessibility contract before implementation.

options.title: Expose Plugin API First
options.body: Keep the feature out of core until a native macOS UI/window plugin API can support a ClawHub implementation.

options.title: Defer persistent desktop bubbles
options.body: Leave HoverHUD, WebChat, TalkOverlay, and Dashboard context surfaces as the supported macOS visibility paths for now.

recommendation.title: Design the macOS bubble contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS owners define the core window, state, routing, persistence, and accessibility contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on adjacent macOS UI/window and selected-session routing surfaces.
